specName: A Build Workflow and Status Badge for Every Repository

FR-002.title: Every product repository has exactly one designated build workflow, same name everywhere

FR-003.title: Build workflow runs on PRs into develop, new PR commits, and changes to develop

FR-004.title: Result shown on the PR; a failure names the step and links its output

FR-005.title: Workflow checks what the repository holds (schemas, host build and tests, site checks, files)

FR-006.title: Maintainer can re-run the workflow without pushing

FR-007.title: Fork PRs get no secrets; nothing is published from a PR run

FR-008.title: Every job runs on GitHub hosted runners

FR-009.title: vscode and eclipse workflows have a step that builds the plug-in and offers it as a run download

FR-010.title: Without plug-in code that step is reported skipped with its reason and does not fail the run

FR-011.title: A run where the plug-in did not build offers no download

FR-012.title: Every repository readme shows its build badge for develop, linked to its runs

FR-013.title: etalii.adp, vscode and eclipse gain a readme with name, purpose and badge

FR-014.title: Both build tables list every product repository exactly once

FR-015.title: Every table row shows the same badge and link as the readme

FR-017.title: Renaming a repo or workflow, or making a repo private, updates every badge and row in the same change

FR-018.title: docs/new-repository.md requires public, workflow, readme badge and both table rows

FR-019.title: Constitution no longer says there is no CI workflow

expectations: marketplace and Releases publishing of the vscode and eclipse plug-ins
context: area: all seven etalii-adp repositories (.github/workflows, readmes)
area: etalii.adp.site home page build table
reference: RUNS_ON switch from standalone PR 93 and site PR 13
constraint: constitution requires CI to validate every example against its schema
intent: Every etalii-adp product repository is public and runs one build workflow on hosted runners, with its badge in its readme and in both org-wide build tables

decisions.decision: vscode and eclipse check the files they hold, and their workflows are prepared to build and offer the plug-in as a run download (Peter, 2026-09-27, answer 1a)
All product repositories become public; this supersedes the earlier non-goal of not changing visibility (Peter, 2026-09-27, answer 2b)
Hosted runners only; the RUNS_ON switch is removed and self-hosted runners are no longer involved (Peter, 2026-09-27, answer 3c)
The .github repository is out of scope: six product repositories only (Peter, 2026-09-27, answer 4b)
One build.yml named Build in every repository
decisions.why: standalone already uses it, so its badge survives and every URL derives from the repo name

decisions.decision: Site ci.yml becomes build.yml with a push-to-develop trigger; deploy.yml stays separate
decisions.why: the badge must reflect PR checks and develop, not Pages deploys

decisions.decision: etalii.adp validates examples with a small Python jsonschema script
decisions.why: examples use a $schema URL with a $defs fragment that CLIs cannot map to the local schema
decisions.rejected: check-jsonschema or ajv-cli with a hand-kept mapping

decisions.decision: vscode and eclipse run editorconfig-checker plus JSON/YAML parse checks, and a prepared plugin job that skips with a notice
decisions.why: both already carry .editorconfig; Peter asked for plug-in download preparation

decisions.decision: IntelliJ gets a minimal build.yml (JDK 25, xvfb-run ./gradlew build, zip upload); spec 005 grows it

decisions.why: otherwise a red PR run shows as the repo status
decisions.rejected: unpinned badge as standalone has today

decisions.decision: Going public waits for a gitleaks history scan, a third-party licence list and Peter typed confirmation per repo
decisions.why: visibility change cannot be undone once content is seen
decisions.rejected: flipping visibility with the workflow PRs

plan.summary: Plan: build.yml named Build in six repos on ubuntu-latest, pinned badges, tables after repos go public
plan.key_finding: Private repos cannot run hosted jobs until public, so their workflow PRs are verified locally and tables change last

approach: Add .github/workflows/build.yml named Build to all six product repositories on ubuntu-latest, removing RUNS_ON, with per-repo checks. Put a develop-pinned badge in each readme, make the private repos public after a history scan and Peter's confirmation, then update the .github profile and site tables and the new-repository checklist.
